117663.name: Chabad of the Capital District
117663.note: Chabad.org obituary on CrownHeights.info, 21 Oct 2026: 'In 1974, the Rebbe dispatched the Rubins to Albany.' The family's shloshim booklet (CrownHeights.info, 5 Nov 2026): 'Rabbi Rubin's shlichus began on Sukkos 5735 (1974), when he and his wife, Morah Rochel, arrived in Albany.' Medium: a death notice (CrownHeights.info, 4 Oct 2026) says Sukkos 5734 (1973).

118281.name: Shabbos House Rohr Chabad Jewish Student Center
118281.note: Chabad.org obituary of Rabbi Yisroel Rubin on CrownHeights.info, 21 Oct 2026: 'In 1975, Rabbi Rubin established Shabbos House, a dedicated Chabad Jewish student center at the University at Albany.' His son Rabbi Mendel Rubin co-directs it now.

119060.name: Maimonides Hebrew Day School
119060.note: Chabad.org obituary of Rabbi Yisroel Rubin on CrownHeights.info, 21 Oct 2026: 'In 1980, Rabbi and Mrs. Rubin founded Maimonides Hebrew Day School'.

117683.name: Chabad House of Delmar
117683.note: CrownHeights.info, 29 Oct 2016: 'Bethlehem Chabad has had a presence in the local community since 1986 when Rabbi Nachman and Clara Simon launched Chabad of Delmar.' Clara Simon (CrownHeights.info, 5 Nov 2026): they 'moved to the Albany area in 1985 from West Hartford'.

118613.name: Chabad of New Paltz
118613.note: CrownHeights.info, 18 Feb 2007: Rabbi Moshe Plotkin, 'who with his wife Bracha settled in New Paltz in August 2003 and since then has entertained students from their home'.

119462.name: Camp Emunah
119462.note: CrownHeights.info, 26 Dec 2025: 'Camp Emunah, the pioneering Chabad girls' overnight camp, was founded in 1953 by Rabbi Yaakov Yehuda (JJ) Hecht and his wife, Rebbetzin Chave Hecht'. Where it was at first is not checked.

119793.name: Camp Gan Israel
119793.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 Aug 2006: 'The flagship Camp Gan Israel is celebrating its golden jubilee this Sunday, August 6 - a half century since the Rebbe founded and visited the first campers at the original site in New York.' The original site was not in Parksville (not checked where).

2192617.name: Chabad for Vassar Students
2192617.note: Lubavitch.com, 7 Nov 2025: 'Since moving to Poughkeepsie thirteen years ago, Rabbi Daniel and Dalia Sanoff have been building connections with Jewish students at Vassar'. Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing went up 30 May 2013.

2509685.name: Pardess Chabad Farm
2509685.note: Lubavitch.com, 14 Oct 2026: 'Rabbi Zalman and Goldy Sandhaus, two Brooklyn natives with no experience of rural life, arrived in southern Dutchess County in 2014.' Its chabad.org listing went up 19 May 2014.

3703105.name: Colonie Chabad Chai Jewish Center
3703105.note: Chabad.org on CrownHeights.info: Rabbi Mordechai Rubin 'has directed the Colonie Chabad Chai Jewish Center near Albany, N.Y., alongside his wife, Chana, since 2018'; CrownHeights.info, 1 Aug 2019: 'The couple moved to Colonie just a year and a half ago'. Medium: its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on 4 July 2017.
